subject.title: Fix chat scrollbar not reaching bottom during streaming via scroll anchoring

question: Is the documented resize-during-streaming drift acceptable for this focused bottom-follow fix, with the fuller architectural remedy remaining in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/996?
rationale: The recording demonstrates meaningful improvement but also a remaining user-visible limitation that tests and CI cannot decide is acceptable product behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded fix
options.body: Merge after current-head checks pass, retain the resize limitation as explicit follow-up work in the Reactor migration discussion.

options.title: Require resize convergence first
options.body: Keep this PR open until the timeline also remains reliably bottom-pinned through viewport resizing during streaming.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded fix
recommendation.body: Merge after current-head checks pass, retain the resize limitation as explicit follow-up work in the Reactor migration discussion.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available recent contributor for the related chat UI behavior and can provide the technical context for the trade-off.
